description: Angular component for a help popup UI element, managing help content display, icons, and popover behavior.

classes.name: HelpPopupComponent
classes.description: Angular component class for help popup functionality, including content handling and popover toggling.

methods.name: ngOnChanges
methods.description: Handles input changes, updates safe HTML for trigger text, and sets text mode.

methods.name: disabled
methods.description: Determines if the help popup should be disabled based on content availability.

methods.name: toggleHelp
methods.description: Toggles the visibility of the help popover if not disabled.
